# Inertia Guangzhou (广州易纳科技有限公司)
> ISO 13485:2016 certified medical device manufacturing collaboration, quality control, inspection & testing, and assembly.
> Chinese subsidiary of Canada's Inertia Group Inc. Dual-shore: Guangzhou + Toronto.
> Model: supply-chain / OEM manufacturing collaboration — the Guangzhou facility provides engineering support, quality control, inspection & testing, assembly, and manufacturing project coordination; plastics, metal fabrication, welding, and surface finishing are delivered through a mature collaborative supply chain.

## Credentials (资质)
- ISO 13485:2016 Medical Device Quality Management System
  - Certificate No: HG25MD0030R0S
  - Identical standard: GB/T 42061-2022
  - Issued by: Crown Certification & Inspection Co., Ltd.
  - Valid: 2025-10-23 through 2028-10-22
  - Scope: sale and export of mobility aid components
- No in-house cleanroom (do not claim cleanroom assembly).

## Scale (规模)
- Employees: 18 total (6 engineering/R&D, 8 manufacturing & quality)
- Facility: approx. 800–1,000 m² (Panyu, Guangzhou)
- Capacity: approx. 200–1,500 units/month (depends on product complexity and supply chain)
- MOQ: no fixed minimum; evaluated per project
- Prototyping lead time: 2–4 weeks
- Founded: 2018 (parent company Inertia Product Development founded 2004, Toronto)

## Manufacturing Capabilities (制造能力)
### Guangzhou facility (in-house)
- Assembly & packaging
- Quality inspection (IQC / IPQC / FQC)
- Functional testing
- Tooling & fixture application
- Manufacturing project coordination
- Engineering support

### Supply chain (collaborative)
- Injection molding & plastics
- Tubing / profiles
- Metal fabrication & welding
- Powder coating / painting
- CNC precision machining
- 3D printing
- SMT / PCBA
- Wire harness
- Rubber / silicone

## Inspection & Testing (检测能力 — 44 calibrated instruments)
- Dimensional & geometric: calipers, ID/OD micrometers, pin gauges, height gauges, feeler gauges, taper gauges, ultrasonic thickness, runout
- Mechanical & assembly: Shore hardness, push/pull force, spring tension, torque testing & tool calibration
- Appearance & surface: color difference, gloss, coating/film thickness, light transmittance, luminous flux
- Environmental & reliability: salt spray, drying/temperature control, infrared temperature
- Battery & others: 8-channel battery test system, electronic counting scale

## Medical Device Categories (可承接医疗器械类别)
- Ventilator / oxygen system accessories
- Mobility aid components and assisted-mobility products

## Clients (已授权公开)
- Baylis Medical (manufactured 100% oxygen accessory for ventilators during COVID emergency demand)
- Amico, Qvella, Raz Design, Cellview, Nuvio, Nexus Robotics (logos used with permission; project details TBD)
